topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the quill and the book, hidden beneath some old seeds in a chest. I should not have looked, but curiosity is a hard root to pull. There it was, my story, written as if I was some hero in a tale. It’s not as if I’ve done anything grand, just worked the land, tried to pay the tithes on time. I worry now, what will come of these writings. What if others see? What if it brings trouble? The saint’s day is near, and I’ll be at the church, as is right, but my mind will be on this. I must think on what to say, what to do, to set things right.
